messages:
alex: hi all! starting today. question: where do I post my intro and also who to ping for laptop + GitHub org invite? the onboarding doc mentions a few channels and i'm a little lost

ricardo: welcome @alex! intro post = #new-hires (short bio + timezone + what youre working on). For hardware and access: #help -> tag @it-support. For infra/GCP/GitHub org invites ping #eng-infra and mention your manager

people-ops: quick intro template we use in #new-hires: 

```
Hi, I'm Alex (they/them), backend eng, SF. Starting on ingest team. Office days: Tue/Thu. Happy to be here! :wave:
```

we also ask everyone to add a calendar block for "onboarding time" so mentors can schedule 1:1s

infra-bot: alex, see automated checklist: 1) fill https://redwood.internal/onboard-form 2) DM @infra-bot `request access` 3) post hw/software req in #help -> we will create ticket

it-support: for laptop/monitor requests put one message in #help with subject line: "HW Request - <Your Name>" and attach your preferred monitor model. For GitHub org invites, include your corporate email and team slug. Note: org invites require manager approval; please CC them

alex: thanks! any rules about bots and private channels? i need the CI bot in private team channel for deploy notifications

tanya: adding bots to private channels requires a ticket in #eng-infra (so we can update ACLs). Short rule: if bot reads build logs or posts deploys it's ok; if bot can trigger actions ask security/infra first. Also avoid inviting third-party bots into private channels without approval

ricardo: etiquette tip: post access requests publicly in #help or #eng-infra to allow teammates to triage. Only move to DMs or private threads for secrets (e.g., key material). Use reactions for acking (:white_check_mark:) and thread replies to keep main channel uncluttered

people-ops: onboarding-bot can auto-subscribe you to calendar/benefits and create an intro post draft. DM `onboard subscribe` to start. Avoid @channel pings for routine requests during PST core hours (10-4) unless it's urgent

alex: oh one more: where do I ask about getting Slack custom emoji and profile picture guidance?

it-support: emoji = #random-emoji (small request there) or file a ticket in #help with image attached. Profile photo guidance in handbook -> people-ops will approve public-facing profile pics on request

tanya: final note: if youre copying templates from older threads, remove internal project names before posting in public channels. helps prevent accidental leaks

alex: perfect, thank you all! posting intro now :seedling:
